failure_mode: An answer that mixes patient facts and guideline evidence must cite each sentence to the right kind of source: the patient's A1c cites the fact, the target cites the guideline chunk; a sentence quoting a target not in the passage is stripped.

chunks.title: ADA Standards 2025
chunks.quote: An A1C goal below 7 percent is appropriate for many nonpregnant adults without significant hypoglycemia. Less stringent goals, such as below 8 percent, are appropriate for people with limited life expectancy.

sentences.text: The most recent A1c was 8.8 % on 2026-09-15, above the reference range.
For many nonpregnant adults the ADA suggests an A1C goal below 7 percent.
Guidelines recommend an A1C goal below 6.5 percent for this patient.
